74:1: O you wrapped in your cloak!
74:6: And do not confer favor expecting more.
74:7: And be patient for your Rabb.
74:9: That day, then, is a harsh day,
74:10: A day not easy for the disbelievers.
74:11: Leave Me with the one whom I created alone,
74:12: And for whom I made extensive wealth,
74:14: And I paved the way for him with ease.
74:15: Then he desires that I add more.
74:16: No! For indeed he was stubborn toward Our verses.
74:17: I will drive him onto a steep ascent.
74:19: May he be destroyed, how he measured!
74:20: Then may he be destroyed, how he measured!
74:23: Then he turned his back and grew arrogant.
74:24: He says: 'This is nothing but sorcery handed down.'
74:25: This is nothing but human speech.
74:26: I will cast him into Saqar.
74:27: And what made you know what Saqar is?
74:28: It neither leaves behind nor does it spare.
74:31: And We made the keepers of the Fire only angels, and We made their number only a trial for those who disbelieve, so that those who were given the Book may attain certainty and those who believe may increase in faith, and those who were given the Book and the believers may not doubt, and those in whose hearts is a disease and the disbelievers may say, 'What did Allah intend by this example?' Thus does Allah send astray whom He wills and guide whom He wills; and none knows the soldiers of your Rabb except Him; and this is nothing but a reminder to mankind.
74:32: Nay, by no means! By the moon,
74:33: And by the night when it retreats,
74:34: And by the dawn when it brightens,
74:35: Indeed, it is one of the greatest,
74:37: For whoever among you wills to advance or lag behind.
74:38: Every soul is a pledge for what it has earned,
74:39: Except the companions of the right.
74:43: They said: 'We were not among those who performed salah,'
74:44: 'And we were not feeding the needy,'
74:45: 'And we used to plunge in vain discourse with those who plunged,'
74:46: 'And we used to deny the Day of Recompense,'
74:48: So the intercession of the intercessors will not benefit them.
74:49: Then what is the matter with them that they turn away from the reminder,
74:50: As if they were frightened wild donkeys,
74:52: Nay, every person among them desires to be given unfolded scriptures.
74:53: No! Rather, they do not fear the Hereafter.
74:54: Nay, indeed it is a reminder.
74:56: And they will not take heed unless Allah wills. He is worthy of being feared, and worthy of granting forgiveness.
